description: Douglas C-47 c/n 20507 converted by Basler to BT-67 turboprop standard, delivered to TAM in 1993 as TAM-38 for counter-narcotics work, crashed at Chimoré in 1995 and written off (Aerospotter TAM list: deactivated September 1997). Rebuilt over three months by III Brigada Aérea personnel and unveiled in October 2023 for the FAB centenary as the largest of the nine aircraft in the 'Plaza de Aeronaves' (eju.tv, 22 October 2023).
